# Optional SDM Integration Dependency

The complete course project integrated the divider with a MASH 1-1 sigma-delta modulator
provided by another course team (referred to as Group 4 in the original project files).
Those third-party course sources are not included in this public portfolio package.

The integration wrapper and testbench are retained to demonstrate the interface and the
verification work. To reproduce the integration regressions, authorized users should
place the corresponding SDM sources in the expected local project location and update
simulation commands as necessary.

Do not publish or redistribute another team's RTL/netlist/SDF without their permission.
